chunks: When man is afflicted with adversity he calls to Us, whether lying on his side, or sitting or standing. But when We take away his troubles, he moves away, as though he had never called to Us in affliction. In the same way, attractive have been made their deeds to the prodigals.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how humans behave when they are in trouble versus when they are comfortable?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological phenomenon of 'amn min al-ba's' (complacency after relief), where humans attribute their deliverance to chance rather than divine grace. It serves as a critique of the 'musrifin' (those who exceed limits in sin), whose ingratitude is aesthetically pleasing to them, reinforcing the need for constant dhikr (remembrance) even in prosperity.
